summary: Resurface and refine. A leave-on chemical exfoliant that dissolves dullness to reveal a luminous, high-fidelity complexion.
description: Precision resurfacing. This optimized blend of alpha and beta hydroxy acids sweeps away dead skin cells on the surface while simultaneously unclogging congestion deep within the pore lining.
technical_overview: Offered at $28.0 for 120ml, this KoColor EXFOLIANT is expertly formulated with Glycolic Acid (8%), Lactic Acid, and Salicylic Acid (2%). It delivers a high-fidelity Clear Fluid color profile (`#FFFFFF`) and leverages multi-depth chemical ablation.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Apply to a cotton pad and sweep over clean, dry skin 2-3 nights a week.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Skip your retinoid on the nights you apply this to prevent compromised barrier function.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Buffered to a precise pH of 3.5 to ensure maximum acid efficacy with minimal inflammatory response.
